title: provider_config output
description: An adapter agent's confirmed configuration: what to offer and how, with the adapter's endpoint. Without a version, the validation candidate (the latest confirmed version); with one, that confirmed version. Null until its publisher first confirms an announced version. Without a version, `announced` also carries the announced version waiting for its publisher's review, if any, so an adapter deployed without its agent.json lists the announced tools.

version.description: This configuration's version; 0 before the first confirmation.

config.description: The confirmed agent.json; null before the first confirmation.

active_version.description: The active version: the one whose validation last passed, which the network lists and admits calls under; 0 before the first validation passes.

announced.description: The announced agent.json waiting for its publisher's review; null when none waits. Present only when no version was asked for.

agent.purpose: Finds active for-sale homes in supported US areas.
